title: How to Fix South Korea-Ukraine Relations
gist: A dispute over Ukraine's transfer of two captured North Korean soldiers to South Korea led Seoul to recall its ambassador on October 8 and plan to withdraw about half its embassy staff on October 20. Short excerpt.

insights.claim: Ukraine transferred two North Korean soldiers captured in Kursk in January 2025 to South Korea in mid-September, and Zelenskyy announced the transfer at the UN General Assembly on September 23, which started a spat.
insights.speaker: Jason Cox
insights.so_what: Shows how a quiet deal turned into a bilateral rift.

insights.claim: South Korea recalled its ambassador to Ukraine on October 8, its first protest recall since 2008, and on October 20 announced plans to withdraw roughly half its embassy personnel; Seoul demands acknowledgment and an apology while Kyiv considers the matter closed.
insights.speaker: Jason Cox
insights.so_what: Strained ties could affect Korean involvement in Ukraine-related defense or reconstruction work.
